sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:49

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:49:1
items.html:
The names of Ehyeh, which are exactly in the manner of the filling of the nine HaVaYaHs, etc.: For HaVaYaH and Ehyeh are the aspect of male and female, the male being the one who bestows,
and the female being the one who receives. And therefore it is impossible for the female to have movements other than what is in the male. And therefore all the movements of the nine names of Ehyeh are equal to the nine HaVaYaHs, without any difference between them.
